questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg valgte Norge fordi jeg ville prøve at studere fisk, og der var rig mulighed for det i Bergen. Bergen er omgivet af fjeld, så naturen havde også en stor betydning.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Bergen var en perfekt by, både i forhold til størrelse og så var der så mange søde mennesker.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Jeg syntes jeg fik alt den info jeg behøvede på mail fra Uib.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik ingen assistance da jeg ankom, men jeg valgte også at bo privat. Jeg kunne google mig til alt.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer:
Det var okay nemt, jeg fandt et værelse på
FINN.no
. Det var også en god pris.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Jeg var rigtig glad for at finde housing off campus, syntes jeg mødte mange lokale og fik noget Bergen "insider" som andre af dem jeg mødte som boede on campus ikke fik.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Det var rigtig let at registrere sig til kurser.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Jeg havde fundet kurserne hjemmefra som jeg ville tage, så jeg meldte mig bare til da jeg ankom.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Man kunne altid skrive en mail til sit fakultet hvis man havde spørgsmål, eller møde op på student info.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik alle de kurser jeg havde valgt.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Gå efter det kursus du gerne vil ha, jeg ved at selvom man kommer på en venteliste til et kursus skal man nok komme på - hvis man møder op til de første forelæsninger.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Jeg syntes de var en okay level, måske lidt mindre level end på KU.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Go undervisning, mere intimt fordi der ikke var så mange mennesker på et kursus som på KU. Måske lidt mindre professionelt til tider.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
FISH BIOLOGY 1 - anatomi
FISH BIOLOGY 2 - physiology 
natural resources management

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg var glad for mine fiske kurser, men "natural resources management" var et online fag, som jeg ikke var helt klar over da jeg valgte det. Det var et okay kursus, men svært ift. man skulle lave alt selv derhjemme, uden en underviser.

questions.answer: Ikke andet end Norge er et dyrt land

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Mad generelt, og alkohol:)

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Jeg var med på fjeldture en gang om ugen, ellers yoga. Nogle af mine venner var også rigtig glade for alt hvad SAMMEN fitness havde af aktiviteter.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: 100% fjeldturene, hvis man ikke vil tage dem alene syntes jeg man skal joine SAMMEN.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Fjeldture, eller holde øje med begivenheder på facebook i Bergen. Der er altid en aktivitet man kan tage til.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Det var nemt, Bergen eller Norge generelt er ret lig med Danmark, syntes jeg.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Fjeldturene var gode til at socialisere, ellers drak vi lidt øl på de lokale bare eller fællespisninger.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Ikke rigtig noget ud over sproget ikke er det samme, men man kan komme langt med dansk.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Jeg syntes nordmænd er rigtig flinke, så det var jeg glad for.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Vandrestøvler, Regntøj+paraply og uldtøj.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Ved ik.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Hvor langt man når ved at være åben og positiv.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Dyrt sted at bo, men ikke et problem hvis man har overblik over økonomien. Regnvejr, selvom jeg ikke syntes det var så slemt.

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: Nej.

questions.question: Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
